findings.text: The terminal-phase branch of _plan_review_worker_finished has no test: every case drives the manifest-status clause through runs._round_has_delivered (the pointers the tests write carry phase 'working'), so deleting lines 2381-2382 leaves the suite green while a pointer left at a terminal phase whose manifest is gone (a cleaned run directory) again holds the compose gate.

The sidecar read re-implements the record reader plan_review already owns (plan_review.py:1482 _load and plan_review.py:1507 _read_record, same json.loads plus OSError/JSONDecodeError returning None), so a change to that contract, or the within-pass cache _load provides, does not reach this reader.

Both fallbacks in _plan_review_plan_path are untested: every case supplies pointer['plan_path'], so a regression in the repo/docs/plans resolution or the mount-registry resolution goes uncaught while any pointer lacking a recorded path would compose a duplicate review.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Traced the three production callers of _standing_plan_review: plan_review.py:4313 _owed_review_skip_reason (the compose refusal), obligations.py:1847 _plan_review_this_request_awaits (the queued-row reading) and recovery_review_dispatch.py:2557 and :2580 in _dispatch_text_review_for_run; all three now compose a review of the newer version rather than name the older one.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 2e5707a407 adds _composed_review_directory, _plan_review_worker_finished, _plan_review_reads_current and _plan_review_plan_path and reorders the two skips in _standing_plan_review (recovery_review_dispatch.py:734, 2368-2470, 2514-2520), 707e6684b2 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names four measures -- a complete-manifest review of vN composing a review that reads vN+1, a working current-version review answering with its own run id, a scope-covering working review answering the same, and a negative control returning the old id -- and tests/test_compose_not_answered_with_older_review.py:215, :231, :243 and negative-control.log carry each one; the all_debug gate it names ran as job 1314507 and is recorded in the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is that a plan review composed for a newer plan version is not answered with an older one; recovery_review_dispatch.py:2517-2520 now skips a pointer whose worker has ended and one that reads neither the current version nor every changed unit, and recovery_review_subject.py:1093 confirms a real composed pointer carries the report directory as its write path, so _composed_review_directory resolves outside the fixture.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, it records base 51 passed EXIT=0 and after 56 passed EXIT=0 with the three named logs, and each of base-arm.log, after-arm.log and negative-control.log was opened and ends on a bare EXIT= line under a revision header.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The node was fenced to four declared paths (three files plus a figures directory); git diff --stat ca3eecced3..707e6684b2 lists exactly three paths and every one is inside that fence, and the figures directory is simply unused.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows test_a_delivered_review_does_not_answer_a_newer_plan failing at line 204 with 'r-plan-review-older-version', so reverting the two skips reddens the suite; the terminal-phase branch at :2381 and both plan-path fallbacks at :2456 and :2462 however have no case that fails if they are removed.
justifications.evidence: base-arm.log records 51 passed EXIT=0 at ca3eecced3 and after-arm.log 56 passed EXIT=0 at 2e5707a407 (exactly the five added cases), and negative-control.log reddens at the pre-change reader with the old run id printed in the traceback.
justifications.fit: The additions are private helpers with the module's own docstring voice and its function-local 'from reckon.crew.node import _TERMINAL_RUN_PHASES' idiom, and no added name carries a version, plan label or stage identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: recovery_review_dispatch.py:2517 and :2519 skip a finished worker and a review whose scope does not cover the newer plan, which is exactly the incident the plan records at work-flows-to-the-lane.html:250 (pointer at promotion-requested, record unstored, every compose answered with the old run id).
justifications.reuse: The change extends the owners it should (plan_review._section_digests, _normalise_sections, TRACED_UNITS_KEY, _REVIEW_SIDECAR_NAME, and runs._round_has_delivered) and folds _composed_review_run_id onto the new _composed_review_directory, but the sidecar read at :2405 duplicates plan_review._read_record (plan_review.py:1507).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat ca3eecced3..707e6684b2 names only recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_compose_not_answered_with_older_review.py and the evidence fragment, all three of the node's declared write paths.
